cohort: The study focused on term livebirths in 12 hospitals in Nepal, from which babies diagnosed with Birth Asphyxia at >=37 weeks of gestation were identified for demographic review and outcome assessment.
finding: The study found an incidence of Birth Asphyxia (BA) of 6 per 1000 term livebirths in Nepal, identified several obstetric and neonatal risk factors, and concluded that BA significantly increased the risk of pre-discharge mortality.
mod_finding: Instrumented vaginal delivery was identified as a significant predictor for Birth Asphyxia.
